principles: An interpreter decision is authoritative only when its inputs, evidence, alternatives, selected rule and transition are digest-bound.
A role return may preserve or reduce scope, but may not change the selected target or authorize an automatic retry.
A 9.7 role score is not a certification without disjoint independent holdout evidence and zero generated function stubs.
L0 and L1 self-development requires a baseline-versus-candidate experiment with no metric or role regression.
Existing local corpus must be deduplicated and split before targeted external acquisition is allowed.
Declared distribution scripts are project-identity evidence and must not depend on CLI tokens in a repository name.
Unknown project clusters remain research candidates and never promote automatically.
Broad Python project strata remain development debt after narrow-type certification.
Web UI is deferred until the architecture and authority contracts are stable.

deferred.broad_project_types: after interpreter boundary integration and a prospective narrow-type experiment; they remain explicit development debt
deferred.framework_plugin_build: separate lane; repeated recognition gap is real but certification requires an independent holdout, generated-stub receipt and no-role-regression receipt
deferred.L2: proposal and test only with external review
